newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea tenders 115,200T rice to stabilise supply.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea tenders 115,200T rice to stabilise supply.

text.p: South Korea plans to hold on Friday an auction to sell 115,200 tonnes of rice to help stabilise domestic supply and ease domestic rice prices, Agriculture and Forestry Ministry officials said.
"We have been holding a public auction to sell our rice stockpiles every January so far. But this year, we are tendering it today due to last year's bumper crop," an official of the ministry said.
The official said the auction, which would be open to qualified domestic rice wholesalers, would help ease a temporary shortage that occurs in the planting season between April and May every year.
The auction would be done through the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation (NACF), the official said.
The ministry said in a statement that producers' selling prices rose by 5.8 percent to 143,902 won per 80 kilogrammes from 135,968 won at the end of last year.
Consumer prices for rice also rose 4.2 percent to 157,080 won per 80 kilogrammes from 150,830 won at the end of last year.
